T1Distinctiveness.method: Inspected the rendered surface with the single AI OS material treated as removable.
T1Distinctiveness.evidence: The asymmetric dark identity rail, technical provenance strip, large declarative heading, ledger-first workspace and numbered inspector remain a coherent Mez composition without the gradient signal.

T2Repetition.method: Mapped every major region by composition family at desktop and mobile.
T2Repetition.evidence: The application rail, header/provenance stack, operational ledger with inspector, and status distribution use four different jobs and shapes. No metric-card grid or repeated container family is present.

T3MotionTruth.method: Inspected source contract, JavaScript and CSS for motion claims and runtime behaviour.
T3MotionTruth.evidence: The candidate claims no expressive or autoplay motion. Only canonical 120ms control-state transitions exist, and prefers-reduced-motion reduces them to effectively zero.

T4ProductTruth.method: Ran verify_product_ui_contract.py against the seven fixture records, registry, component sources and Figma evidence, then inspected all visible values.
T4ProductTruth.evidence: All records, the five-product summary, 24/18/105 Figma values and the 5/1/1 distribution resolve to named repository sources. The page explicitly denies production-product-data authority.

checked: no generic metric-card dashboard or nested mini-card cluster
no fabricated statistics, customer data, product screens or placeholder marks
no pure-black, purple, glass, blur, decorative shadow or gradient-as-chart-category styling
no colour-only status, hidden mobile records, horizontal body overflow, autoplay or scroll hijacking
one Living Core source image is used once as workspace identity and not as decoration

visualEvidence.results: All seven widths rendered with seven visible records and zero body overflow. At 320–390 the table becomes labelled record fields; at 768–920 the inspector follows the ledger; at 1280–1440 the inspector shares the ledger row.
repairsDuringGate: Moved the stacked shell breakpoint from 920 to 1024 after the exact 920px render exposed 43px of horizontal overflow.
Reduced mobile headline scale so the title resolves as two strong phrases rather than a five-line word stack.
Turned the four rail items into real bounded views instead of decorative navigation.
Added modal background isolation, focus trapping, focus restoration and JavaScript-disabled access to the complete fixture.

findings.finding: The browser accessibility tree proves names, roles, table structure, aria-sort, live regions and chart alternatives, but an external VoiceOver or NVDA spoken session has not been recorded.
findings.effect: No Gate B visual blocker; keep the exact spoken-output session as a named follow-up before canonical promotion.

smallestNextStep: Present the single operational-ledger family at H-UI-01. If Olli keeps the grammar, obtain one real redacted Mez product workflow and test the accepted shell against it before expanding the component inventory.
